$comment: Personal style. Everything here is LOCKED across videos; per-video judgement goes in projects/<slug>/edit.json.

brand.$comment: Colours come from config/themes.json[theme]. primary/ink/paper/accent below are DERIVED at render time; do not hand-edit.

keyword_pop.$comment: Big words that pop when the speaker says them. size in px on a 1080p-high canvas; sfx from assets/sfx.

inserts.$comment: Picture-in-picture cards (maps, screenshots, meme stickers). Rendered from templates/cards/*.html to PNG.

outro.cta_zh: 点赞 · 收藏 · 关注

rules: Jump cuts only. No dissolves between talking-head shots.
One keyword pop per idea, never two on screen at once.
Subtitles use the SCRIPT text, not the ASR text (ASR fixes homophones wrongly).
Retakes: keep the LAST take, cut everything from the first false start to the restart.
Bleep is for genuinely awkward moments only; never on the punchline.
Chinese and English versions share the same cut; only subtitles, pops, cards and cover text change.
Never yellow/black sticker styling. One theme per video from config/themes.json; accent used once per frame.
Editorial typography: the larger, the lighter — display serif at regular weight with wide tracking; small labels uppercase mono.
